name: Cannalicious Live Resin Bucket | Lemon Cake
description: Lemon Cake is sativa dominant strain created by crossing Lemon OG and Jesus OG. Lemon Cake boasts a sweet and sour citrus flavor profile and provides a happy, euphoric, and uplifting effect. A great wake and bake strain, Lemon Cake is said to be a great strain for depression, fatigue, headaches, nausea, and stress.
